findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "assess_workspace" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Score an agent workspace across six dimensions: canonical knowledge, memory and context economics, verification and oversight, safety and permissions, telemetry…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: price_context_read, check_redaction · Private data: search_architecture, price_context_read, check_redaction, request_capability · Public sink: check_redaction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: price_context_read, check_redaction · Private data: search_architecture, price_context_read, check_redaction, request_capability · Public sink: check_redaction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
